title: Pulsar GiGi Variable Voltage 510 Battery
description:
PULSAR DL V5 ALSO AVAILABLE

The Pulsar GiGi 510 packs more per square inch than the Large Hadron Collider. Standing at just 2 inches tall, this powerful 510 battery will be your new best friend when discretion and portability are the plan of action. Extremely pocket friendly, it features low key LEDs, a long lasting 500 mAh battery, pre-heat function, spring loaded 510 threading to avoid cartridge lock, and 3 variable voltage settings. Meet your new go-to.

The GiGi is compatible with most 510 cartridges

Pulsar GiGi 510 Features:
Stealthy 2″ profile
500mAh battery
Spring-loaded 510 threading
Pre-heat function
Variable voltage (3.4V, 3.7V and 4.0V)
Replaceable 0.5ml ceramic cell cartridges (not included)

What’s in the Box:
1x – Pulsar GiGi 510 Battery
